keyFindings.description: SPEC_CHECK_REMINDER, appended to the dispatch_issue result when a spec is given (:2180) and to dispatch_request_approval's (:2974), tells every session to have `plan-gap-analyst` on Oh My Pi check the spec. The Dispatch tools are the Envoy plugin's (envoy.ts:1617 executeDispatchTool), so the sentence reaches a session with @sjawhar/pi-envoy alone, which no longer ships that agent (round 1 finding 1, one channel over), and it now contradicts skills/dispatch-first/SKILL.md:53, which names `scout` for Oh My Pi and reserves plan-gap-analyst for a Legion session. The new guard reads skills only and matches task(agent=…), so it cannot see prose in a tool result. Fix: reword the reminder as the skill is worded (or defer to the skill without naming an agent), update the three assertions (dispatch-advice.test.ts:253, dispatch-execute.test.ts:3840, :3905, :3958), and rebuild packages/claude-envoy/dist in the same commit (check-dist compares a fresh build; dist/envoy-channel.js and dist/session-hook.js carry the string).
